game.name: Flatout Ultimate Carnage (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: FlatOut Ultimate Carnage on Xbox 360 offers you the chance to indulge in crazy and spectacular races. Many game modes are available (time trial, carnage races, beat the bomb, stunts, deathmatch derby, etc.) as well as a multiplayer mode. Destroy your opponents' cars to win all the challenges offered.
